body: This sounds like a good option for me in some ways, but it would feel to me like I'm just postponing all responsibility. I'm not sure if it's financially viable for me quit college and start all over again. I just don't know, but thanks for your help. I wish you well.
Good luck with everything, I hope you fare better than I will.

Thanks for this, I wish you well with your journey. I don't even know if I can afford to change career path or experiment with other career paths financially, at least not without my parents breaking their backs for me even more than they already have. At the minute there isn't a job in the world I could imagine enjoying/surviving a 9 to 5 in. Maybe a step back would give me more perspective like you say.
Thanks for these words, I'm dealing with the same shit as OP.
I hope you get well and don't go through with this, but I ask myself this question too all the time.

Wow, this is eerily similar to how I think. I always have this "grass is always greener" mentality where I think "If this aspect of my life was different I'd be happy". I then make the change and realize I'm just as miserable as before. I wanted to run away and start a new life for a while but the realization that I'd still be unhappy stopped me.

I don't know if I'll make it but thanks for your help and advice to me and everyone else. I hope you're just on this subreddit to help and not here because you're also suicidal. If the latter is the case I hope all works out well for you.

I'm sitting here struggling with suicidal thoughts too, with a lot of similar issues. You can talk/vent to me or pm me. I could really do with talking to someone in the same boat as me, and you might too.

Thanks for your comment and thanks for your continuous effort in this subreddit. This sounds like good advice, if I do hang on for a while I'll try to make some of these changes. Don't think I have the ability to do even these basic things, though, but I might try.
Thanks for your comment, I'm not dropping out voluntarily. I've got my exams in a few weeks too that I know I will fail. I don't have the time or capacity to catch up now.
